desc: The ELEMENT HUNTER is specifically designed for the rugged, unforgiving terrain and extreme weather conditions found in the mountains of Idaho. The Element Hunter features the Element M3 barreled action with our FIRST Carbon fiber barrel. Specifically designed and contoured for hunting. The Chassis is also designed specifically for hunters. This is NOT a tactical rifle slimmed down to save weight. This chassis has all of the fit, form, and feel of a traditional hunting stock, while offering all the modularity and features of a chassis-style rifle: folding, slim and snag-free stock perfect for packing and quick to deploy, adjustable cheek piece, full-length MLOK rail on a traditional style fore end, AND now Seekins Quick Change Barrel Collar allowing you to change calibers to meet your every hunting need. The Element Hunter is the perfect mix of past and future, created by hunters for hunters.
